scope: App-owned Greek temple information UI, interface mix, numeric toolbar presentation; local mock only, stills only.

One to three orb flight voices divide gain by sqrt(voices), retaining a constant summed squared-gain budget without changing cast voice, impact or animation clocks.
Mode table now explicitly states natural 4+ Aegis entry or 100x buy. Summon-and-throw wording also applies to FG forehead glasses.
